FamilySearch collection 2255317 ('Pennsylvania, Death Certificates, 1906–1968') is the free indexed source. A certificate naming both parents would be direct evidence — the single highest-yield source for confirming Thomas Flynn as father and identifying the mother's name.

FamilySearch provides free indexed access.
